name: Jira

comment_on_selected_work_item.name: start a comment on the selected or open work item

steps.note: the vendor pages give no key for saving the comment

tips: Press ? on any Jira page to open the shortcuts dialog; it shows the keys for the current operating system and browser, grouped as global, navigation, work item actions and app-specific.
Shortcuts can be switched off in that dialog; if single keys do nothing, check that the toggle there is on.
Some shortcuts need specific permissions or installed apps, so not every key works for every account.
In the text editor: / opens quick insert (tables, images and more), @ mentions a person, : inserts an emoji.
The editor accepts Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "# " to "###### " headings, "* " or "- " bullets, "1. " numbered, "[]" action item, "> " quote, --- rule, ``` code block.
